en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪਿਉ ਕੁਛੜਿ ਲੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhraoo hasadhaa ghar aaiaa kar piaar piau kuchhaR leetaa|

en.bdb: Boy Dhru came smiling to his house (palace) and his father full of love put him into his lap.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਹੁ ਪਕੜਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੇਈ ਕੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: baahahu pakaR uThaaliaa man vich ros matreiee keetaa|

en.bdb: Seeing this, the stepmother got angry and catching hold of his arm pushed him out of the lap of the father (the king).

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੁਡਹੁਲਿਕਾ ਮਾਂ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸੁਰੀਤਾ?
verses.translit_en: dduddahulikaa maa(n) puchhai too(n) saavaanee hai k sureetaa?

en.bdb: Tearful with fear he asked his mother whether she was a queen or a maidservant?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹਾਂ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: saavaanee haa(n) janam dhee naam na bhagatee karam dhiraRheetaa|

en.bdb: O son! (said she) I was born queen but I did not remember God and did not undertake acts of devotion (and this is the reason of yours and mine plight).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਦਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੂ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ?।
verses.translit_en: kis udham te raaj mil satraoo te sabh hovan meetaa?|

en.bdb: With that effort can the kingdom be had (asked Dhru) and how can enemies turn friends?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਿਦੂ ਹੋਈਐ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: paramesar aaraadheeaai jidhoo hoieeaai patit puneetaa|

en.bdb: The Lord should be worshipped and thus the sinners also become sacred ones (said the mother).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਰਣਿ ਤਪੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਤੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: baahar chaliaa karan tap man bairaagee hoi ateetaa|

en.bdb: Listening to this and getting totally detached in his mind Dhru went out (to the jungle) to undertake rigorous discipline.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: naaradh mun upadhesiaa naam nidhaan amio ras peetaa|

en.bdb: On the way, sage Narad taught him the technique of devotion and Dhru quaffed the nectar from the ocean of the Name of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: pichhahu raaje sadhiaa abichal raaj karahu nit neetaa|

en.bdb: (After some time) King (Uttanpad) called him back and asked him (Dhru) to rule forever.
The gurmukhs who seem to be losing i.e. who turn their faces from the evil propensities, conquer the world.
